quote: BYD Energy Storage will supply Grenergy with a total of 6,240 units of its MC Cube-T model—equivalent to 624 containers—that will be used to develop the storage system for the Elena plant, a key phase of Oasis de Atacama with 446 MW of solar capacity and 3.5 GWh of storage.
note: Opened Grenergy 20 May 2025 English release. Distinct from byd_grenergy_central_oasis_2026 (Central Chile 2.6 GWh).
